scope.multistep_semantics: Boolean class-level composition envelope plus exact middle-witness relational joins

normalization.input: each one-step bipartite support S_r has a unique perfect matching mu_r

main_theorem.criterion: C_h has unique perfect matching identity iff union_r Gamma_r is acyclic
main_theorem.equivalent_certificate: all normalized noncanonical one-step support edges admit one common topological order
proof_kernel: union_r Gamma_r is contained in the off-diagonal support of C_h because all other time steps may follow diagonal identity edges
every off-diagonal edge of C_h is induced by a path in union_r Gamma_r, hence lies in its transitive closure
therefore the endpoint ambiguity digraph is acyclic iff the union digraph is acyclic
with the identity matching present, unique perfect matching is equivalent to absence of an alternating/directed ambiguity cycle

witness_refinement_theorem.fine_endpoint_support_bound: I subseteq J_h subseteq C_h whenever canonical matched chains are realizable
witness_refinement_theorem.universal_safety: every compatible fine witness realization has unique canonical endpoint identity iff union_r Gamma_r is acyclic
witness_refinement_theorem.positive_direction: if C_h has unique identity, every intermediate exact support J_h containing I and contained in C_h also has unique identity
witness_refinement_theorem.negative_direction: if C_h is ambiguous, a join-saturated witness realization using one boundary token per class/time realizes J_h=C_h

same_support_two_step_separation.filtered: same A,B; private noncanonical tokens plus shared diagonal tokens realize identity-only endpoint support; identity unique
